Ce se întâmplă atunci când o fiară însetată de sânge găsește o mireasă a luminii în ținutul morții?
După ce a gustat-o, ca un dependent, voia mai mult. În cenușiul lui, ea era explozia colorată. Ea era a lui.
ATENȚIE! Genul de carte pe care o citești cu inima strânsă și o recomanzi obsesiv.
Pentru că există cărți bune. Există cărți intense. Și există FINISHER: mai periculos, mai erotic, mai întunecat ca niciodată. Alessandro „Alpha” Villanova și Zephyr rescriu regulile puterii, dorinței intense și supraviețuirii.

Crescut în haos și sânge, Alessandro „Alpha” Villanova a ajuns de la nimic la tronul unui imperiu criminal despre care orașul vorbește numai în șoaptă. Puterea lui e reală, frica pe care induce tuturor e meritată, iar singurătatea este prețul pe care l-a plătit pentru supraviețuire.
Zephyr de la Vega vine dintr-o lume complet diferită – una în care grijile sunt mărunte, iar viața se desfășoară liniștit. Până când o întâlnire neașteptată o aruncă în brațele celui mai periculos bărbat din oraș. Iar propunerea pe care i-o face îl obligă pe Alpha să deschidă o ușă pe care o ținuse baricadată ani întregi.
În timp ce un ucigaș în serie își croiește drum prin teritoriul lui Alpha, sfâșiindu-i imperiul bucată cu bucată, iar Sindicatul intră în scenă, alianța lor devine exact cum nu ar trebui să fie: intimă, incendiară, imposibil de controlat.
Lumina și întunericul nu ar trebui să se atingă.
Răul se ridică. Întunericul coboară.
O nouă ordine se naște.

About the author

RuNyx

19 books23.5k followers
RuNyx is a New York Times, USA Today and international bestselling author of romance. Her stories range across subgenres from dark contemporary to gothic to historical to fantasy and more, and are currently being translated into over 10 languages.

Her pen name has a very special meaning to her. When she's not writing, she's reading, traveling, meditating, daydreaming, and most of all, procrastinating.

i am in shock… omfg…

ok so this book follows zephyr and alpha (yeah that’s his name) and the best way to describe this book is dark mafia romance + grumpy X sunshine + second chance + marriage of convenience all in one. and i fucking loved it.

now i’d say the underlying plot that connects all the books together was done the best in this one. i did not see shit from a mile away. the shit that was unraveled towards the end had me gasping out loud, smacking my hand to my forehead, and running it down my face.

zephyr and alpha..god i love them. it’s the way he’s so possessive over her and the way she teases him that gets to me. it’s like poking a bear with a stick, literally because apparently he’s this beast like man with a monstrous cock that you’re reminded about every few chapters.

zephyr is a fucking baddie and i love her. she’s so funny and side note but i loved the fact that she’s unapologetically a curvy woman. she’s lusted and pined after like she deserves.

and ngl the dante & amara cameos were one of my favorite parts. they are still my number 1💞💞💞

"You're a twisted beast. I'm a twisted beauty. Were totally meant to be, handsome. It's written in fairytales."

Omg this book 😭😭😭 I loved it so muchhh. These characters were new. We were only introduced to Alpha for a little part of the last book and Zephyr was totally new we knew nothing about her at all but this books amazed me by managing the same plot with new characters on a entirely new location while still managing to connect it with the ongoing story. Runyx was incredible with the characters here. Don't get me wrong the plot was good but the characters were dealt with so well here. The thing that I liked about RuNyx is that she has a different style of writing for each couple because I felt different emotions while read the predator and the reaper, different when I was reading the emperor and different with this. So I can easily vouch for RuNyx being one of the greatest dark romance authors out there who actually give two fucks about the plot.

"You are hope sunshine. Hope for a better life."

The plot, the twists and the worldbuilding. Oh my god I was absolutely amazed by how well paced the plot was and how it had a natural flow despite surrounding around new characters and with the main characters from the previous books as minor characters. The twists were jaw dropping like why do you keep doing that 😭😭 it hurts. Stop. This also has a very traumatic scene between Tristan and Morana that I love so much it's my favourite scene if the series 🫣 also I wish we got it from there perspective. The inclusion of SHADOWMAN was really well done he is an intriguing character and I can't wait to see how it goes with him. The world building was 🤌 literally if you want a good dark romance READ THIS!

Tropes in this book
-Marriage of convenience
- Amnesia
-Spice
-grumpy X sunshine
-Groveling.

"Men in our world don't find love, brother. Don't let it go. Whatever you need, I'm here."

Alpha was literally a grumpy broody cinnamon roll. He was tall, massive and so hot. I loved his character thought I wanted a little more communication between alpha and zephyr but I still enjoyed it nonetheless. I would have also loved more flashbacks tbh that was the part that felt missing from the book however his amnesia trope imo was done perfectly and this is coming from someone who hates that trope but here it was really fun to read about and the trope just added and elements of mystery in it so it was very enjoyable. I also liked how his character fit in this book as it wasn't that dark but he made it work.

"She loved too much, trusted too easily, got hurt too often, and maybe she needed to harden herself. But she would lose the essence of who she was if she did, and so she never did. Feeling hurt was more acceptable than feeling dead."

Zephyr, AAAH she was the most different FMC that I have read as of yet. She was quirky, sassy and tried to hide her grief beneath a smile. What I loved about her was she knew what people thought of her but she didn't care because she loved herself as she was and that was 🤌 zephyr also was very smug and every interaction that she had with alpha were either very fun or very hot. I love how Runyx has different blends of characters. The portrayal of her insecurities was done well as well and the part that I liked the most was that she made Alpha grovel like honestly Runyx is the only author I trust in this genre to deliver on mmc's and fmc's.

"Holding her hand while she slept, he cried in a hospital after twenty years."

Romance, I feel like out of all the book in this series this was the most character driven and it had a lot if impact on the romance (in a good way) the spice was handled very well and the patience that zephyr had with alpha was absolutely amazing, how she gave him his space as he tried to remember, helped him remember and I loved how protective and loving alpha was of zephyr. Runyx really be out here writing the best romance novels. Also Idk why I think I'm cursed but that alpha breaking a woman's hipbone during sex because he was too rough was hot for some reason 😭

Overall, it was really fun!

"Who. Am. I?"
"My husband."
"And who are you?"
"Your wife."
"Mine."

Huh so that was unexpectedly mild. I thought it would be dark but instead I was met with fluff which really impacted my enjoyment levels. I had a whole lot of expectations from this given the first three books in the series were really good. This one is probably the weakest book in the series for me.

See it's not bad but it's not anything special either. When you have Tristan Morana and Dante Amara as leads in the previous books, Alpha and Zephyr don't really leave that much of a mark. They're quite forgettable imo. Don't get me wrong, I liked them both but they really didn't stand out compared to other characters.

Alpha was okayish. He's the sort who hates everyone but her. I liked how he slowly warmed up to Zephyr. I didn't like the nickname he gave her tho, it was kinda meh. Zephyr had more depth to her, her emotional and mental battles made me sympathize for her. I have went through similar sort of struggles, so her story really touched me. But apart from that, she was just okayish too. I liked Zenith tho. I loved her..... 🥹🥹

The romance was fluff. The spice was hip breaking. The marriage of convenience was a possessive one. So in short, fun.

Plot wise? It was a let down. There were just glimpses of the Syndicate and what's cooking behind the scenes. I wanted more of that. I had also hoped I would see Vin in it, but I didn't.. So hopefully in the next one.

The ending was damn good. I loved it. I cried. But I really loved it. Ahhh I cannot wait for the next one, I hear it's much darker.. Which is what I want 👀🫣

OK, IM CALM NOW!!!!! SUPER CALM!!! DON'T YOU SEE ????????? eye twitch.

I have to say, possibly this book would have had a higher rating if I hadn't been in a slump. Once again I have to say that I am not a dark romance girly, and that this series is my first dark romance so my opinion may differ from a regular reader of the genre.

I am highly surprised with this book, in the content warnings, it was written that this book would be darker than the previous ones, but I think that Alpha and Zephyr are the softest couple of the series, I am not complaining at all, this book made me cry a lot, a lot of soft moments between them AAAAAA!!! wipes tears.

‘love that went so deep into the bones it changed the course of being’


・┆✦𝓹𝓵𝓸𝓽✦ ┆・


I don't think it's convenient to really explain what this book is about, since the less information you know and the more blindly you approach it, the more everything surprises you, therefore, I'm going to explain it very ambiguously.

Zephyr, following her boyfriend, finds out that he is being unfaithful, there she meets Alpha, an old boyfriend, when Zephyr confronts him, she realizes that he does not remember her, and she forms a plan to make him fall in love again.

'it was a kiss, both new and familiar, like a melody she'd heard long ago and never forgot'

This has been a very, very poor way of describing the plot of the book, but really, listen to me, the less you know, the better.

Runyx is a true genius, when you think you've caught her she turns everything around and you're left with a clown's face and your jaw so low that a building fits in your mouth.

'I've loved you as a boy, and I love you as a beast. All of you have always been loved by me.

・┆✦𝓬𝓱𝓪𝓻𝓪𝓬𝓽𝓮𝓻𝓼✦ ┆・


✦𝒜𝓁𝓅𝒽𝒶: Ok, I really liked Alpha, especially the mystery about his past and identity. Emotionally he is ruined, his life has been very hard, and he thinks he no longer has the capacity to love. He has many scars, on his face and body, plus the lack of an eye, I'M JUST SAYING, HE WEARS A PATCH. I LOVE HIS AESTHETIC NOT GOING TO LIE HERE. I would have liked to read more of his points of view, I think it was a little unbalanced in that sense.

‘He was a protector; he always had been. That was one of the things she’d loved the most about him’

✦𝒵ℯ𝓅𝒽𝓎𝓇: MOTHERFUCKING CURVY ASS BITCH QUEEN SLAY. I think you all got it. I love Zephyr very much, I felt super identified with her. She is a happy woman, who loves her body and knows its value, but still has insecurities since people keep telling her what is the best for her and her body. SHE IS PERFECT. She is literally a ray of sunshine in a gray cloud. She is a WOMAN, with all the letters, she changes her hair color depending on her mood, she supports each and every woman, I don't understand how anyone could not love her. It's early to say, but she may be my favorite girl in the series.

‘She loved too much, trusted too easily, got hurt too often, and maybe she needed to harden herself. But she would lose the essence of who she was if she did, and so she never did. Feeling hurt was more acceptable than feeling dead. The ugly in her head got awful’

・┆✦𝓻𝓸𝓶𝓪𝓷𝓬𝓮✦ ┆・


I loved it and I cried like a baby omg, I think they are perfect for eachother. I will quote my baby siff here, in her review she describes them like this: ‘zephyr is the only woman who could ever match alpha, and alpha is the only man who could ever handle zephyr.’ AND I CANT AGREE MORE.

‘My life has been nothing but gray for as long as I remember. Rainstorms and thunder clouds that never went away. You filtered through that, all bright colors and exuberance and life. And the clouds are still there, but my eyes can’t leave the rainbow long enough to see them. You changed things.’

I liked the smut, even though Alpha held back a lot at first because he broke his last lover's hip (yes, you read that right HAHAHA). I think they are underrated, reading the reviews I have realized that they are not very loved by the fans, and I really don't understand why.

・┆✦𝓺𝓾𝓸𝓽𝓮𝓼 𝓘 𝓮𝓷𝓳𝓸𝔂𝓮𝓭✦ ┆・

3.5 stars

While the first half of this was mostly on the lighter side, the last few chapters were absolutely criminal. RuNyx is such a mastermind with her plot twists and ability to connect everything. me and hoda predicted who the culprit was but the other twist was such a shock?! It left me theorizing EVERYTHING that it felt like this finished me

This read more like a dark rom com with the fluff we’re met with initially and a contrast to the previous ones. it all felt fitting considering how true the calm before the storm? was shown here given how it ended and the little I know of how dark the Annihilator is.

Alpha and zephyr and their love was.. unconventional from the other couples in being less intense and low on angst yet its own thing and sweet all the same

Zephyr screamed sunshine yet was also someone who dealt with her own share of issues that made her character feel relatable enough. I felt for her and adored her plenty tbh. Aside from that, I thought her humor was cringe sometimes but it was also pretty hilarious 😂 her determination to make alpha fall in love was sending me. i loved how open she was with her sister in telling her this too. She was completely bold and knew what she wanted by going after it. I did like seeing her try to break down alphas defenses until I wanted her to stop because he needed to see what it would look like to lose her. She truly was a ray of sunshine in his dark world

With alpha, it was obvious how darkness surrounded him throughout his life with what he’s been through. I wanted to slap the missing sense into him but ended up meeting his rough edges with more understanding and acceptance. Especially once he warmed up to zephyrs affections and made the effort to work on things. i thought it was ultimately sweet how he saw her, like when he talked about her many smiles as it was reflective of him paying attention to everything about her where she was concerned. They were cute

This wasn’t my favorite in the series, however, it wasn’t bad as I thought and did really enjoy it. I would've loved to have gotten more their past together as it was more tell than show but I did see that its possible for that to be a possibility one day. i also liked the crumbs of everyone as brief as it was since it gave us a glimpse into the found family they’ve all made with each other. the bonus scene with Tristan and Morana during a certain scene here is a must read if you haven’t read it. that moment of angst was also endearing to read about 🥹 loved it.

Thank you to my love hoda for the br 🥰 I had such a fun time reading and reacting to it all with you 🤭 can’t wait to do this again. her review highlights more

I have a love-hate relationship with this series. I like the books, but they bore me in the middle and then make me love them in the ending. The start is always amazing! Even though this book has all my favorite tropes and I totally enjoyed the start, I kinda got bored in the end, but the last 15% is totally worth it!

Zephyr — Unlike Amara and Morana, she had a really nice life. I'm not complaining lol, but I understand why everyone was wary of her since she was new. Personally, I related a lot to Zephyr and her struggles. No doubt she was a bit clingy, but at least she was confident and eventually found love. It was quite touching how she never gave up on her love from a decade ago!

Alpha — Is he good? Yes. Better than Tristan and Dante? No. 💀 Hskshsjs I'm currently having Tristan-fever rn, and even though Alpha is endearing, I prefer the first two characters. Alpha, unlike Dante, doesn't show emotions openly, but he isn't emotionless. He's considerate, caring, and I appreciate all he does for everyone, always ensuring their protection. He truly has a heart of gold!

➤ The story was super fast-paced in the beginning, and Zephyr did some things that I would never do. She literally said, 'MARRY ME' 😭 hahahaha she was so overconfident, but I'm glad she didn't experience second-hand embarrassment by getting rejected. I don't blame Alpha for keeping his distance, he has trust issues and has suffered a lot. 🙂

➤ He lost his memories of Zephyr and the torture he faced when he lost his eye. The few past scenes (literally only one and some dialogues 🤡) that were given to us like crumbs WERE SO GOOOOD??!!! I wanted to cry. 🥲 I loved them, and there should have been more.

➤ The shadow man is being a bitch. What the fuck do you mean by 'should've sought me before' after getting Zenith killed? I KNOW IT'S NOT HIS FAULT, but why the fuck would he say this even though Alpha clearly ASKED him who the Fortis Killer is? Hypocrite double standard idiot 😭 (I'm so sad for myself because I would've been interested and all that who's his TOY is, but I already know 🤡)

➤ Tristan and Morana are literally occupying my thoughts 24/7. When Morana got shot hskxhsjs I've read Tristan's POV on that scene, and I WANT MORE 😭. The way Tristan went all feral, broke all speed limits, and even told her that they'd get a cat.

first of all, i’m in a little bit of a review slump right now, so this review probably isn’t gonna be as good as it could have been <3 anyway, this book is such a comfort read for me, and i don’t know what exactly makes this book feel like such a comfort read for me, but i maybe have an idea or two, but we’ll get to that. zephyr and alpha is probably the most “normal” couple, in the dark verse series universe. these two have always been such an adorable couple (imo) they’re just so precious, and i always appreciate a good second chance romance book. this book has always hit me a little differently from the others in the series, and i’ve tried to figure out why, but i just can’t.

again i’m not gonna do a full summary, because of spoilers, but i’ll explain a little about the book; this book is about zephyr and alpha, and them finding their way back to each other. which is a little complicated, because they were in a relationship when they were teenagers, but something happened to alpha and he lost his memory and disappeared for many years. and then suddenly zephyr is at an underground fighting match with her shitty new boyfriend alec, where she sees alpha. and then she slowly realizes that alpha doesn’t remember her. this isn’t a full or good explanation in any way, but i don’t wanna say more, because i think you need to read it and find out for yourself <3

side note; as i’ve said in my previous reviews for this series, please don’t look this series up on social media, because of possible spoilers. this series needs to be read without knowing much about it, for the full experience and the jaw-dropping plot twists.

characters:
zephyr de la vega / rainbow
zephyr is such a girls girl, she’s always doing what she can to make sure other woman are comfortable, and she’s always hyping them up. i’m actually so in love with zephyr’s character ! she’s not for everyone tho, which i both understand and don’t understand. she’s goofy, determined, no filter, supportive, etc. she’s just such a woman istg. she actually reminds me a little bit of bryce from the crescent city series, and if you’ve seen my review for that series, you know i love bryce. there’s so many things i love about zephyr’s character e. g. her changing her hair color after her moods, the way she’s always hyping other woman up, the way she makes sure people around her are comfortable, etc. she’s just so precious and i love and adore her so much <3 zephyr is confident yet insecure. she’s almost always comfortable in her own skin, even tho everyone besides her sister, and alpha, is constantly telling her to loose weight. but zephyr is not only hyping other woman up, she’s also hyping herself up, which i find so admirable. she’s truly just a real woman in my eyes.

“𝙎𝙝𝙚 𝙬𝙤𝙣𝙙𝙚𝙧𝙚𝙙 𝙬𝙝𝙚𝙣 𝙬𝙖𝙨 𝙩𝙝𝙚 𝙡𝙖𝙨𝙩 𝙩𝙞𝙢𝙚 𝙝𝙚’𝙙 𝙗𝙚𝙚𝙣 𝙚𝙢𝙗𝙧𝙖𝙘𝙚𝙙 𝙬𝙞𝙩𝙝 𝙡𝙤𝙫𝙚, 𝙖𝙣𝙙 𝙝𝙚𝙡𝙙 𝙝𝙞𝙢 𝙩𝙞𝙜𝙝𝙩𝙚𝙧.”


alessandro villanova / alpha / mr. hip crusher
probably one of the most emotionally ruined mmc i’ve ever read about, just my type fr. alpha has been through a lot, from a very young age. his character development is so good (imo). he went from a cold man without a heart, to a still cold man but with a heart for his woman, again, just my type. zephyr is the perfect match for a man like alpha, and he’s the perfect man for a woman like zephyr. alpha has always found himself ugly, but not in a way where he pitted himself, just that he looks rough and has many scars, plus he misses an eye. his story always manages to break my heart, and i honestly just wanna hug the man, but luckily zephyr will do that for me.

⎯ zephyr is the only woman who could ever match alpha, and alpha is the only man who could ever handle zephyr. this couple is so underrated, which actually annoys me, but i do understand. as i’ve said these two are the most “normal” couple in this series, well they’re not exactly normal, but compared to the rest they are. these two’s journey always makes me so emotional. these two are the perfect example of learning to grow and love together, without giving up (imo). what i think makes these two a comfort couple for me, is their journey, their healing, and the way they are with each other. i also love how everyone has always made zephyr feel like shit about her body, and then there's alpha making her feel like the smallest, most beautiful woman, that's just too cute, it makes me wanna cry.

“I might not remember you,” he whispered, his lips almost at hers. “But you’re my wife now. Mine. And I’d bathe this whole city in blood before I let you change that.”


I just love RuNyx, her mind, her words, her storytelling so much.

A dark, twisty marriage-of-convenience story in a mafia world with a second-chance trope? This book was so addicting from start to finish. I know this was still a dark romance book, but there was more fluff and wholesomeness in this book rather than the dark elements for which the Dark Verse series is famous. Not that I’m complaining, because I enjoyed the story, literally devoured it in just a few days, and loved Alpha and Zephyr because they were both just so adorable. But I just expected more.

The blade came to her chin then, almost like his fingers always did, directing her focus back to himself. “Who am I?” he demanded quietly, her face level with his waist, her eyes enraptured with his.
“What?”
“Who. Am. I?” She swallowed.
“My husband.”
“And who are you?” Her mouth parted.
“Your wife.”


I liked the murder-mystery subplot in this book, but there wasn’t as much focus on The Syndicate as in the previous books. The Finisher was more centred on Alpha and Zephyr’s relationship, their fake marriage, and why someone is trying to frame Alpha for the murders happening in his city. I was definitely shocked by the ending and the jaw-dropping plot twist. RuNyx never fails to surprise me with her mind-fucked plot twists. I have developed trust issues because of this series.

Zephyr de la Vega is a lover girl. I love her character so much. She’s such a sweet, caring, sunshine girl, literally an angel, always helping and supporting people who need comfort, care, and love. What I loved most about her is how she loved complimenting and hyping people up when they looked good or did something good because she knew how important it is to hear compliments. She was a plus-size heroine, but she never felt unsure or uncertain about her body type. She had her own insecurities, but she never let them overpower her, and I loved how she didn’t try to compare her body with others. She owned her body confidently, embracing her chaotic and hopelessly romantic heart with every fibre of her being.

“She wanted to seep down to his dried roots, nourish the soil of his heart, and fill him with life again.”


Alessandro Villanova, or Alpha, is the grumpiest MMC in this series, with the most terrible and brutal past. He was a protector and a fighter all his life, and I respect him so much for the way he built his own empire from nothing. I still don’t know or understand how he managed to break some girl’s hips, but considering his sex drive, I think anything is possible. He wanted to give Zephyr every beautiful thing, and even though he didn’t remember her anymore, he still fulfilled his promise to her and his mother. He carried his scars without shame, but he was also drowning in self-pity—until Zephyr just barged into his life one day, kissed the hell out of him, and asked him to marry her. He didn’t know how to express his emotions except through his grumpiness about almost everything, but I liked how he went through impressive character development.

“He needed her kiss to make it through, like she was salvation for his sins.”


Zephyr and Alpha are the most underrated couple in this series, and maybe it’s because of how normal their dynamics were when they met again. But that’s exactly what makes them special. Zephyr and Alpha complement each other so well—they fit so perfectly into each other’s lives, even with their polar opposite personalities. Zephyr is the sunshine—or, as Alpha says, a Rainbow—to his dark life. She might have lived a comfortable and lovely life, but she always knew the struggles and brutal reality he endured. Alpha didn’t know what gentleness and love were after losing his mother at a very young age, Zephyr brought all the love, comfort, warmth, and joy into his life with her jovial personality, and the way he made her feel like she was the smallest and most beautiful thing in the world with his little actions—like carrying her and picking her up—was just so sweet and adorable. I loved that she was always the one leading her relationship with Alpha. Her seducing tactics might seem funny at first but I admire her for how she just give give and give Alpha her everything without asking him for anything in return. I loved how they both just didn't helped each other grow but they learned to actually grow together.

“You know how a rainbow is made?” Zephyr frowned.
“When sunlight passes through a raindrop.”
“My life has been nothing but gray for as long as I remember,” he told her softly. “Rainstorms and thunder clouds that never went away. You filtered through that, all bright colors and exuberance and life. And the clouds are still there, but my eyes can’t leave the rainbow long enough to see them. You changed things.”


I also loved Zenith and Zephyr’s love for each other and the way they both cared for and loved each other. It was so precious and beautiful. I thought I would be okay with the classic RuNyx trauma dumping in her books, but I AM NOT OKAY—not after knowing what Zenith had to endure before she escaped. She deserved better than just that fucked-up ending, but I was happy for her, knowing she had Zephyr in her new life, who loved her wholeheartedly. I will never forgive RuNyx for that ending. How dare she break my heart? I don’t even want to think about it again.

I’m so excited for Shadow Man in the next book. He’s just so hot and mysterious, you know? Definitely my type.

Well, that was.......... different. 🙈😂

Ok, so we are back with book four in our Dark Verse universe and it's a new city with new main characters. Zephyr, a 29 year old hair stylist with a heart of gold is running out of time to get married in order to get her inheritance when by chance she runs into Alpha (aka the hip crusher), a huge beast of a man with one eye and the leader of his own underworld organization, but she knows him, a first love that she lost many years ago and now that she has found him again, she is determined to get him back. There is only one problem though, he doesn't remember her bc of the accident he suffered that left him sans one eye. Zephyr will not let anything stand in her way and she concocts a plan to marry Alpha under the guise of her inheritance but the only thing she really wants to gain is Alpha's heart.

This book was a weird transition from book 3. I was expecting something else I think, but from pretty much chapter one I had to adjust my expectations and kind of just embrace the chaos. This is definitely not the sweeping romantic vibes of Tristan and Morana or Dante and Amara, but it is cute and endearing and parts are funny, really, really funny. More ironically funny but it still counts!

I wasn't a huge fan of Zephyr out of the gate, but she did grow on me and by the end I loved her. Alpha is........ Ok, I don't know what Alpha is but I know that I love him! 😂 He is an underdog for sure with a heart of gold and even though he may not be romantic or say the right things he means well, and he loves big!

And speaking of BIG..........haha! You guys KNOW I have to address the elephant in the room, and I am guessing its the size of an elephant bc WHAT IN THE EVER-LOVING HELL? HOW DO YOU BREAK A WOMANS HIP WITH YOUR LUGGAGE DOWN THERE SIR?!!! I have never laughed so hard in my life! Seriously, it's not the dream, please authors just stop, none of us are fantasizing about permanent sex injuries impairing the rest of our lives! All I could think about is this poor woman and how she must be traumatized for life now! Even Alpha said he could still hear the bone snap!!! THE TRAUMA!!!! I mean seriously, LOGISTICALLY, HOW DOES HE EVEN WALK AROUND?!!! JUST STAHHPPP!!! 😂😂😂 I fear that this is going to live rent free in my head forever now, like I am going to be at lunch months from now and this poor woman is just going to pop into my brain!

I loved the cameos of my faves Dante and Amara and also Tristan and Morana and that ending, I was not expecting it to be so emotional!! I can't wait to read the next book and I really need them to find HER!! (if you know, you know)

“You’re a twisted beast. I’m a twisted beauty. We’re totally meant to be, handsome. It's written in the fairytales.”
This book is a masterclass in tension. I started it with serious reservations, ready to dismiss it over my usual dislike for marriage-of-convenience plots and an initial impression of the FMC, Zephyr, as unlikable. But the author executed their dynamic so flawlessly that it completely won me over.
I confess, I nearly cast this gem aside, my bias against the marriage of convenience trope clouding my judgment. But then—Zephyr. Oh, the glorious audacity of her! She saw her storm and, instead of waiting for the thunder, she became the lightning and proposed. A masterclass in taking what you want, ladies. Let us all learn from her. 🤭

“You’re playing with the beast, little rainbow.”
Their dynamic is like if Taylor Swift's 'I like shiny things, but I'd marry you with a paper ring' met a dark romance. Zephyr's version is more like, 'I like the beast, but I'd marry him with a sweet alfajor.' The upgrade we didn't know we needed. 😂

“You’re both my rainbow and my treasure at the end of it. And nothing—” bite “— will—” lick “—ever—” suck “—compare.”
Zephyr and Alpha are a force of nature. Their relationship is a dark, captivating dance of possession and power. He is the beast, a gray storm of intensity; she is the twisted beauty, a brilliant rainbow who refuses to be overshadowed. Together, they are like alpha and beta in the mathematical sense—two complex variables designed to solve for no one but each other.
This series just gets better with every book! Having all the main characters from previous books present makes this world feel so rich and lived-in; it's like tuning into your favorite series where every episode is essential.

"Remember when I told you my heart was a dead scar tissue?" "Hmm." "I feel it pumping again with you. My lifeblood. My little rainbow."
The story brilliantly layers past love and trauma, delivering a powerful message: in the underworld, love and trust are the ultimate risks. He is a man who married a hairstylist out of curiosity, not commitment, and watching him inevitably fall for her is the entire, glorious point.
If you love grumpy x sunshine, second chances, and a marriage of convenience hiding a shared past, this is your next read. He is Alpha, she is Beta. A perfect, tense equation.
And let me just say... some scenes in the final chapters were absolutely not on my bingo card. 😅 I won't spoil a thing, but honestly? I loved every shocking, brilliant moment.

"The gray won't be forever, rainbow." with that quote, I hope the writer will answer all my questions about the very detailed past of Alpha and Zephyr, because she mentioned they have another bigger epilogue that falls after the timeline of the last book in the series.

okay yeah… this one was not for me 😭

i was so excited going in. marriage of convenience? fake love turning real? it had all the things i usually eat up. but somewhere along the way it just… lost me.

alpha was intense but not in the fun, morally grey, mysterious way. more like emotionally unavailable and kind of exhausting. the whole possessive thing stopped being hot real fast and just felt repetitive. i wanted to like him but i found myself rolling my eyes more than swooning.

zephyr had potential. she was soft and sweet but honestly not much else stood out. her personality felt flat at times and her dynamic with alpha never fully clicked for me. like yes the tension was there but where was the connection??

and their relationship… it just didn’t hit. it was a lot of pushing and pulling, claiming and apologizing, and i kept waiting for that emotional payoff that never really came. for a book that’s supposed to be about a relationship built through marriage, it weirdly lacked intimacy. it felt more like vibes than actual love.

plot-wise it had its moments but nothing truly hooked me. the intensity people talk about? i kind of missed it. maybe i was just disconnected but i wasn’t invested like i wanted to be.

overall this wasn’t awful but it definitely wasn’t what i hoped for. some tension, some spice, a lot of confusion 🖤
